classification_rule: Primary is the next work kind, not a claim that all resources for completion are present. Mandatory implementation precedes optional disposition in mixed entries. A supported diagnostic that can be retained has a disposition, not an automatic deletion. Measurement precedes optimization; validation_only closes already-implemented work. Engineering choices are not automatically lead-approval blockers.
inspection_limits: All headings and scoped records reviewed; current source checked for liveness and disputed claims. No new kernel, full-model or numerical gate was executed. Resource availability is bounded to checked roots and the configured HIP environment; no filesystem-wide or remote-host inventory.

definitions.local_implementation: Required code, harness, schema, ownership or repair work can start; later device/model gates remain.

definitions.product_decision: Product, support, architecture, resource or semantic contract choice; not necessarily external approval.
definitions.measurement_first: Run a reproduction, profile or candidate evaluation before choosing an implementation or disposition.
definitions.validation_only: Already-implemented change has remaining public/device verification.
definitions.evidence_binding: Identify the original measured artifact and attach provenance; not product implementation.
